result.title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
result.summary: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history. Existing approaches emphasize recent context or retrieval of related memories, providing limited support for validating recurring behavioral regularities and assessing their applicability to the current event. We propose Proactive Memory (ProactMem), which organizes history into recent events, temporal trajectories, and behavioral regularities. Trajectory facts are checked against source events, and regularities are assessed through historical replay before being matched to current conditions. We also construct ProactiveStream, a longitudinal benchmark covering three application scopes, where agents process isolated event streams chronologically under episode-aware opportunity labels. On ProactiveStream, ProactMem achieves an overall effectiveness (F1) of 52.6%, a 21.4% relative improvement over the strongest of five external baselines. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ProactMem-5351/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ProactMem，将智能体历史组织为近期事件、时间轨迹与行为规律三层，轨迹事实回查源事件、规律经历史回放检验后再匹配当前情境，并构建纵向事件流基准 ProactiveStream，F1 达 52.6%、相对最强外部基线提升 21.4%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「事实回查源事件、抽象规律先经回放验证再匹配当前条件」的流程，可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设与视觉证据的核验、筛选及状态复用提供方法线索，但纯文本智能体记忆与多模态内部状态的差异仍需核查。
